In addition to the JSDoc described in Annotating JavaScript for the Closure
Compiler the following tags are common and well supported by various documentation generation tools (such as JsDossier ) for purely documentation purposes.
You may also see other types of JSDoc annotations in third-party code. These annotations appear in the JSDoc Toolkit Tag Reference but are not considered part of valid Google style.
